translations.web: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.
translations.bsb: and said, “If only you had known on this day what would bring you peace! But now it is hidden from your eyes.
translations.kjv: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.
translations.asv: saying, If thou hadst known in this day, even thou, the things which belong unto peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.
